title: What Invalidates the Setup?

launchpad.outcome: Recognize when to reassess a setup, and keep research notes separate from rules.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What would make you reassess this setup?

beats.title: The active PIL loses structural relevance
Opposing structure materially changes the setup
A newer ICC sequence replaces the old one
The old setup becomes stale or replaced
Correction depth
beats.line: Dayli continues studying how correction depth affects setup quality.

beats.title: Not a rule
beats.line: No “correction > 30 points = invalid” unless it’s an official rule.

slides.headline: Indication ✓ Correction ✓ … then this
slides.line: Watch the structure, not just the PIL.

slides.quote: Don’t confuse research observations with execution rules. The rules are the rules.

slides.prompt: When should you reassess an active setup?
slides.modelAnswer: When new relevant 1M structure forms, the PIL loses relevance, opposing structure changes the setup, a newer sequence replaces it, or the HTF context changes.

takeaways: Pass when the setup no longer stands.
remember: Reassess when the structure that created the setup changes.
